properties.text: Peer-reported custody_group_count must be validated against NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS upper bound before use in any loop or data structure sizing. handle_custody_groups must terminate in O(NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS) iterations regardless of the peer-advertised value.
properties.assertion: forall peer_cgc: handle_custody_groups(peer_cgc, ...) terminates AND iterations <= NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS, even when peer_cgc > NUMBER_OF_CUSTODY_GROUPS

properties.text: Between successive reads of a peer's custody_group_count within checkPeerCustody, the value must not change due to concurrent metadata updates. If lookupCgcFromPeer is called multiple times within one logical operation, either the value must be read once and cached, or the function must tolerate mid-call changes without entering an invalid state.
properties.assertion: forall peer, call_sequence in checkPeerCustody: all lookupCgcFromPeer(peer) calls within one invocation observe the same value OR the function handles mid-call changes safely

properties.text: After a protocol upgrade or fork transition, all peer metadata fields that are semantically redefined by the new protocol version (e.g., custody_group_count becoming meaningful at Fulu) must be refreshed from each connected peer within a bounded time. Stale pre-transition default values (e.g., zero) must not be used for post-transition decisions.
properties.assertion: forall peer, field in fork_redefined_metadata: time_since_fork_activation() > REFRESH_BOUND => peer.metadata[field] reflects post-fork value, not pre-fork default

properties.text: If the implementation caches the result of verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof, the cache key must include all three spec-defined inputs: (kzg_commitments, kzg_commitments_inclusion_proof, signed_block_header). Omitting any input from the cache key allows a sidecar with different commitments but matching proof and header to reuse a stale cached result, bypassing inclusion proof verification.
properties.assertion: forall cache_hit(sidecar_a, sidecar_b): cached_result(sidecar_a) reused for sidecar_b => sidecar_a.kzg_commitments == sidecar_b.kzg_commitments AND sidecar_a.inclusion_proof == sidecar_b.inclusion_proof AND sidecar_a.signed_block_header == sidecar_b.signed_block_header

metadata.note: Manual properties for Sherlock issues #15/#109 (custody_group_count DoS), #216 (stale metadata after Fulu fork), #190 (inclusion proof cache key)
